utilityBlocks.name:
` evaluator's tests need roots that resolve per declaration: several declarations of one
 * property, each reading `--value()` a different way (a bare number, a ratio, an integer, a theme key, an
 * arbitrary value), so a value satisfying two of them survives more declarations than one satisfying a
 * single path. Also negative roots, roots whose declarations sit under `:dir()` nesting, a scale whose key
 * `translate-full` is a key of two namespaces at once, and a colour and a shadow read through `--value()`.
 */
@theme
drift-up-*
drift-inline-*
